g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure active-passive multi-region with Front Door, SQL failover group and geo-redundant storage

g.title: None.None.Node.29
g.text: The site's name resolves in Azure DNS to Front Door
Front Door sends traffic to the primary origin, East US 2, while its health probes pass
The web app writes orders to the failover group's read-write listener
Azure SQL geo-replicates every change to Central US
and the storage account copies documents to the paired region
Sessions live in Cosmos DB, replicated to both regions
Health probes fail, and Front Door sends traffic to the standby web app in Central US
The failover group promotes the Central US database, and the listener follows it
Customers keep their sessions from the Cosmos DB replica
Traffic Manager moves partner webhooks to the Central US worker
